Air-Gapped Container Lifecycle, Hardware Sizing & Benchmarking

Generate pinned, network-isolated Docker and HPC Apptainer configurations, verify model SHA-256 digests, auto-tune local hardware, and benchmark runtime throughput.

emit_docker_compose()

emit_apptainer_def()
Emit an HPC Apptainer Definition File (.def)
verify_model_digest()
Verify SHA-256 Digests of Local Model Weights
is_loopback_endpoint()
Classify and Validate Whether an Endpoint Is Strictly Local / Loopback
preflight_isolation_check()
Run Pre-Flight Air-Gap Isolation and Integrity Verification
estimate_vram_requirements()
Estimate GPU VRAM Requirements for Local Open-Weights LLM Deployment
recommend_runtime_config()
Recommend Optimal Local LLM Configuration for Workstation or HPC Hardware
benchmark_local_runtime()
Benchmark Throughput, Latency Quantiles, and Retry Rate on a Local Runtime

Pre-Inference Privacy, PII & k-Anonymity Risk Engine

Deterministic pure-R PII detection, HIPAA Safe Harbor rules (ages > 89 & restricted ZIP3), zero-PII pre-run audits, and quasi-identifier k-anonymity / l-diversity export controls.

pii_default_entities()
Default Built-In PII Entity Types
hipaa_restricted_zip3()
HIPAA Safe Harbor Restricted 3-Digit US ZIP Prefixes (45 CFR 164.514(b)(2))
pii_config()
Configure Pre-Inference PII Detection and Redaction Rules
pii_detect()
Detect PII Entities in Character Text
pii_redact()
Redact Detected PII Entities from Text
pii_privacy_report()
Generate a Pre-Run Privacy Coverage Report Without Leaking Raw PII
pii_audit_dataframe()
Pre-Inference Privacy Dry-Run Audit for Research Data Frames
assess_reidentification_risk()
Assess Quasi-Identifier Re-Identification Risk (k-Anonymity & l-Diversity)
apply_k_anonymity()
Enforce k-Anonymity (and Optional l-Diversity) on a Research Table

Keyed Pseudonymization & Encrypted Vaults

Reversible RFC 5869 HKDF-SHA256 + HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymization with AES-256-CBC Encrypt-then-MAC vaults and atomic key rotation.

pii_vault_key()
Generate a Cryptographic Secret Key for PII Pseudonymization Vaults
pii_pseudonymize()
Keyed Deterministic Reversible PII Pseudonymization (HMAC-SHA256)
pii_reidentify()
Re-Identify Pseudonymized Text Using a Local Mapping Vault
pii_vault_save()
Save a PII Pseudonymization Vault to a Separate Local File
pii_vault_load()
Load a Saved PII Pseudonymization Vault from Disk
pii_vault_rotate_key()
Atomically Rotate the Master Encryption Key of a PII Vault

Resumable Schema-Enforced & Consensus Batch Extraction

Long-transcript chunking, strict typed schemas, automated structured repair retries, atomic JSONL crash-resumable batch extraction, and multi-pass self-consistency consensus coding.

schema_field()

validate_extraction()

build_repair_prompt()
Build a Structured Repair Prompt for Malformed Model Outputs
airgap_extract()
Run Crash-Resumable, Schema-Enforced Batch Extraction Over a Data Frame
extraction_manifest() extraction_privacy_report() extraction_preflight() extraction_vault() extraction_throughput()
Access Run Provenance and Privacy Metadata from an airgap_extraction
airgap_extract_consensus()

consensus_passes() consensus_diagnostics()
